WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    time,
    bytes_out,
    bytes_in,
    time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip ORDER BY time) AS inter_arrival
  FROM f_network
),
pair_stats AS (
  SELECT
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    COUNT(*) AS n_events,
    MAX(time) - MIN(time) AS span,
    AVG(inter_arrival) AS avg_gap,
    STDDEV_SAMP(inter_arrival) AS gap_jitter,
    AVG(bytes_out + bytes_in) AS avg_bytes
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip
),
beaconing_pairs AS (
  SELECT src_ip, dst_ip
  FROM pair_stats
  WHERE avg_gap BETWEEN 45 AND 75
    AND gap_jitter < 15
    AND span BETWEEN 2700 AND 4500
    AND n_events >= 30
    AND avg_bytes < 2048
)
SELECT g.event_uid
FROM gaps g
JOIN beaconing_pairs b
  ON g.src_ip = b.src_ip AND g.dst_ip = b.dst_ip
ORDER BY g.event_uid

WITH gaps AS (

    time,
    bytes_out,

     AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) BETWEEN 1800 AND 7200

)

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    time,
    bytes_out,
    bytes_in,
    epoch(time) - epoch(LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time)) AS gap_seconds
  FROM f_network
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    COUNT(*) AS n_events,
    epoch(MAX(time)) - epoch(MIN(time)) AS span_seconds,
    AVG(gap_seconds) AS avg_gap,
    STDDEV_SAMP(gap_seconds) AS std_gap,
    AVG(COALESCE(bytes_out, 0) + COALESCE(bytes_in, 0)) AS avg_bytes
  FROM ordered
  GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
     AND AVG(gap_seconds) BETWEEN 45 AND 75
     AND COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(gap_seconds), 0) <= 15
     AND (epoch(MAX(time)) - epoch(MIN(time))) BETWEEN 2700 AND 4500
     AND AVG(COALESCE(bytes_out, 0) + COALESCE(bytes_in, 0)) <= 2048
)

SELECT stage, event_uid, event_time, detail FROM (
  SELECT 'OAuth consent' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, service || ' / ' || api_operation AS detail
  FROM f_api
  WHERE lower(api_operation) LIKE '%consent%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%oauth%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%grant%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, image_name || ' ' || cmd_line AS detail
  FROM f_process
  WHERE lower(image_name) LIKE '%powershell%' OR lower(cmd_line) LIKE '%powershell%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'C2 beacon' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR) AS detail
  FROM f_network
  WHERE lower(protocol_name) LIKE '%beacon%' OR lower(src_hostname) LIKE '%c2%'
     OR dst_port IN (443, 8080, 53) AND bytes_out > 0 AND bytes_out <= bytes_in
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Lateral connection' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR) AS detail
  FROM f_network
  WHERE (src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.%')
    AND (dst_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '172.%')
    AND dst_port IN (445, 3389, 5985, 5986, 22, 135)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'No-MFA privilege escalation' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, service || ' / ' || api_operation AS detail
  FROM f_api
  WHERE mfa_present = FALSE
    AND (lower(api_operation) LIKE '%policy%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%privilege%'
         OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%attach%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%putuserpolicy%'
         OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%adduser%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%escal%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Role assumption' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, service || ' / ' || api_operation AS detail
  FROM f_api
  WHERE lower(api_operation) LIKE '%assumerole%' OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%assume%role%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Data exfiltration' AS stage, event_uid, time AS event_time, src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ' bytes_out=' || CAST(bytes_out AS VARCHAR) AS detail
  FROM f_network
  WHERE bytes_out > bytes_in AND bytes_out > 1000000
) kill_chain
ORDER BY event_time ASC;

WITH seed_user AS (
  SELECT user_uid AS uid FROM f_auth
  UNION
  SELECT user_uid FROM f_session
  UNION
  SELECT actor_user_uid FROM f_process
  UNION
  SELECT actor_user_uid FROM f_api
),
actor AS (
  SELECT uid FROM seed_user WHERE uid IS NOT NULL
),
actor_ips AS (
  SELECT src_ip AS ip FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM actor) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT src_ip FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM actor) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
actor_hosts AS (
  SELECT target_host AS host FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM actor) AND target_host IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT host FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM actor) AND host IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM actor) AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
),
net_ips AS (
  SELECT src_ip AS ip FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT ip FROM actor_ips) OR src_hostname IN (SELECT host FROM actor_hosts)
  UNION
  SELECT dst_ip FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT ip FROM actor_ips) OR src_hostname IN (SELECT host FROM actor_hosts)
),

  UNION
  -- grow the cluster: any seed row sharing a uid, ip, or host with the current cluster
  SELECT s.uid, s.ip, s.host
  FROM seed s
  JOIN cluster c
    ON (s.uid = c.uid)

    OR (s.host IS NOT NULL AND s.host = c.host)
